package.name: arm_task_server
package.description: The robot's manipulator_action_server (status_interfaces/action/ManipulatorTask), the arm commands husky_operations_manager sends during a harvesting operation: GO STOW / GO READY / GO DROP move the arm to a named SRDF state through move_group, START HARVEST runs stow_arm_cpp's cut_stem action. Sim and real robots.
